description: This file contains implementation for managing Git worktrees, including functions for creating, validating, repairing, and locating worktrees, as well as handling worktree-specific configurations and related file operations.

classes.name: worktree
classes.description: Represents a Git worktree with attributes such as path, id, reference info, and status flags.

methods.name: void free_worktree(struct worktree * worktree)
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for a worktree instance.

methods.name: void free_worktrees(struct worktree ** worktrees)
methods.description: Frees an array of worktree pointers.

methods.name: struct:worktree * get_main_worktree(int skip_reading_head)
methods.description: Retrieves the main worktree associated with the current repository.

methods.name: struct:worktree * get_linked_worktree(const char * id,int skip_reading_head)
methods.description: Retrieves a linked worktree by its ID.

methods.name: struct:worktree ** get_worktrees(void)
methods.description: Gets all worktrees, including the main and linked worktrees.

methods.name: struct:worktree ** get_worktrees_without_reading_head(void)
methods.description: Gets all worktrees without reading their head information.

methods.name: char * get_worktree_git_dir(const struct worktree * wt)
methods.description: Returns the Git directory path for a given worktree.

methods.name: struct:worktree * find_worktree(struct worktree ** list,const char * prefix,const char * arg)
methods.description: Finds a worktree by path or suffix.

methods.name: struct:worktree * find_worktree_by_path(struct worktree ** list,const char * p)
methods.description: Finds a worktree by its filesystem path.

methods.name: int is_main_worktree(const struct worktree * wt)
methods.description: Checks if a worktree is the main repository worktree.

methods.name: const char * worktree_lock_reason(struct worktree * wt)
methods.description: Returns the reason why a worktree is locked, if any.

methods.name: const char * worktree_prune_reason(struct worktree * wt,timestamp_t expire)
methods.description: Returns the reason a worktree should be pruned.

methods.name: int validate_worktree(const struct worktree * wt,struct strbuf * errmsg,unsigned flags)
methods.description: Validates the integrity of a worktree.

methods.name: void update_worktree_location(struct worktree * wt,const char * path_,int use_relative_paths)
methods.description: Re-locates a worktree to a new directory.

methods.name: int is_worktree_being_rebased(const struct worktree * wt,const char * target)
methods.description: Checks if a worktree is currently rebasing.

methods.name: int is_worktree_being_bisected(const struct worktree * wt,const char * target)
methods.description: Checks if a worktree is currently bisecting.

methods.name: int is_shared_symref(const struct worktree * wt,const char * symref,const char * target)
methods.description: Determines if a reference is shared among multiple worktrees.

methods.description: Finds a worktree sharing a symbolic ref.

methods.name: int submodule_uses_worktrees(const char * path)
methods.description: Checks if a submodule uses worktrees.

methods.description: Constructs a worktree reference string.

methods.name: int other_head_refs(each_ref_fn fn,void * cb_data)
methods.description: Iterates over other HEAD refs in worktrees and applies a callback.
